title: Federal records to review after a move
facts: A move can require separate updates with federal agencies and programs because there is no universal federal change-of-address system.
Depending on the person, relevant records can include IRS, Social Security, USCIS, U.S. passport records or applications, Selective Service and federal benefit programs.
USPS forwarding is a mail-delivery service and should not be treated as a substitute for updating agencies directly.
State-administered programs such as Medicaid, SNAP, unemployment and DMV records require separate state procedures and can be affected by an interstate move.
